services.name: Sup Tour
services.desc: We require a minimum of 2 paddleboards booked in order to confirm and send out group lessons. Tour minimum does not apply for private lessons. Learn how to really coast with a Paddle Canada Certified instructor. Offered from Granville Island location, we’ll teach you everything from the basics to advanced techniques. You’ll hone your overall technique by learning new paddle strokes, strengthening your core, and learning how to make more efficient use of your muscles. Whether you’re looking for an introduction to paddleboarding or an advanced lesson, our Paddle Canada Certified Instructors will tailor an experience to your needs. Reservations are required. blurb: Vancouver Water Adventures offers guided tours and rentals on jet skis, kayaks, paddleboards, and Zodiac boats showcasing Vancouver's scenic waterways and landscapes. They provide tours ranging from high-speed Zodiac boat rides to beginner-friendly kayaking and paddleboarding lessons. Private bookings are available for exclusive and personalized experiences.
